subject: Lane D Cycle 2 TEST: paired cold/warm model isolates cache divergence and rejects cross-process overclaim
body: Paired synthetic model passed four falsification assertions: same-process MISS->failure vs HIT->success exposes cache as first modeled state difference; process restart forces CROSS_PROCESS interpretation; capture ENTER without RETURN remains ambiguous absent death evidence; topology churn alone remains UNCLASSIFIED.

model_assertions.case: capture ENTER without RETURN and no death marker
